A '''sweetmelon''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],  offered sweetmelon [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] as an optional flavoring for the [[fizzyglug]] drinks it sold.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sweetmelons were first mentioned in the [[2001]] novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Menu" />
